title: add RAG agent templates and tool-calling quickstarts + docs site updates
author: Sofia Kim
description: Context: Add a small curated set of RAG (retrieval-augmented generation) agent templates and end-to-end tool-calling quickstarts to help developers get started with agent patterns on Redwood. Motivation: users repeatedly ask for copy-pasteable agents that demonstrate (1) document retrieval + tool calling, (2) multi-tool orchestration, and (3) graceful fallback to non-tool responses. This PR adds template code, example prompts, test fixtures, and docs site pages with runnable quickstarts. Changes include: - new examples under redwood-examples/agents/rag-templates (Python + TypeScript) - quickstarts showing tool registration, tool schemas, and response parsing - docs site pages and sidebar updates under redwood-docs/docs/agents/rag - small SDK helper for tool calling wiring (thin wrapper, no behavior change) - unit tests and integration smoke tests for examples What I changed at a high level: - Added three agent templates: rag-basic, rag-multi-tool, rag-fallback - Added two quickstarts: python-tool-calling-quickstart, ts-tool-calling-quickstart - Updated docs site nav and example pages with step-by-step instructions - Added CI smoke test that runs the Python quickstart in a mocked sandbox Note: this PR intentionally keeps examples dependency-free (uses only redwood-sdk and a tiny local memory store) and includes copy-paste snippets for the docs site. Checklist: - [x] Add template code and tests - [x] Add docs pages and sidebar entries - [x] Add CI smoke test - [x] Validate TypeScript examples compile - [x] Confirm no breaking changes to SDK Usage: See docs site pages for step-by-step commands and expected outputs. Related: builds on top of prior work ENG-3971 (agent tooling API) and references multiple example PRs in redwood-examples.
